references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native shape: a hooded figure in a deep red robe with a rope belt and long sleeves, pale narrow face under the cowl, one hand raised holding a swirl of violet magic.
Shipped The Master (upright crimson robe with a staff and no hood): the elder vampire is HOODED, in a burgundy robe with a rope belt and a swirl of violet magic in one raised hand, no staff.

prompt_fields.subject: An elder vampire seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle: a hooded figure in a long mid-light plum-violet robe with wide sleeves and a pale-gold rope belt, the cowl pulled up over a pale narrow face with pale glowing eyes and long thin fangs, one hand raised low holding a compact bright swirling wisp of lilac-white magic, the other hand hidden in a sleeve, the hem of the robe brushing the base. No staff, no cape, no red anywhere. Ancient, sinister and complete, clearly lit.
prompt_fields.contrast: Vampire family, four grades, plus the shipped The Master: the elder vampire is the HOODED PLUM-VIOLET robed figure with a lilac-white wisp in one hand (silhouette: pointed hood over a long conical robe, one raised hand; hue: plum-violet with pale gold; value: mid-light). The lesser vampire is an orange-tunic young man, the vampire a crouching scarlet-caped figure, the master vampire a tall indigo cloak, and the shipped The Master a crimson-red robe with a staff and no hood: the elder must NOT be red.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures. Calibration from the previous generation of this exact token: it was drawn too dark and too small to read at 48px next to the other undead tokens. This time the creature is clearly LIGHTER, with strong light highlight planes on the upper-left of every fold, plate and limb, and it fills about four fifths of the disc radius around the disc centre (the figure and all its equipment stay inside that circle), while the disc stays exactly at the reference lightness.
prompt_fields.palette: Mid-light plum-violet robe lifted with much lighter lilac-mauve fold highlights, pale-gold belt, bright lilac-white magic wisp, pale skin and eyes; the robe is mid-light overall with the cowl interior as the only dark area; the magic must not cast light, glow or a cast onto the disc. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.
